curation.curated_by: MedTwin asset curation (automated inspection + curator notes)

notice: All anatomy here is generic educational reference geometry. None of it is the patient's anatomy, and no finding is spatially registered to it.

mapping_categories.SPATIALLY_REGISTERED: Image-derived finding placed through validated registration. Not available: no registration is validated.
mapping_categories.VERIFIED_ANATOMICAL_REGION: A clinician-confirmed report statement naming a region that maps to a labelled atlas structure.
mapping_categories.SCHEMATIC_ORGAN_ASSOCIATION: Evidence associated with an organ by its documented text or analyte; the highlight is organ-level and schematic.
mapping_categories.UNSUPPORTED_MAPPING: Evidence with no defensible anatomical association.

systems.label: Heart
systems.summary: External and internal cardiac anatomy from attributed educational models, plus a structure-labelled in-body atlas heart.
limitations: Generic reference anatomy; no patient-specific cardiac geometry.
Ejection fraction or chamber volumes are never derived from these models.

systems.label: Lungs
systems.summary: Lung, airway and bronchial reference models; the atlas variant labels individual lobes and the tracheobronchial tree.
limitations: Generic reference anatomy; lesion overlays require a validated detector and registration, neither of which is configured.

systems.label: Brain
systems.summary: Exterior brain surfaces, a lobe-labelled model and a structure-labelled atlas brain (brainstem, cerebellum, telencephalon).
limitations: Lesion and tumour overlays require validated stroke/tumour models with matched labels; none is configured.

systems.label: Liver
systems.summary: Liver surfaces, a vascular graft-planning model, and the atlas liver with Couinaud segments I–VIII.
limitations: Fibrosis stage, steatosis or lesion burden are never inferred from a generic liver model.

systems.label: Pancreas
systems.summary: Pancreas surface, an authored cross-section, and the atlas pancreas with main and accessory ducts.
limitations: Metabolic markers (glucose, HbA1c) are not anatomical pancreatic findings and are never mapped onto pancreatic geometry.

systems.label: Intestines
systems.summary: Small and large intestine model plus atlas segments (duodenum, jejunum, colon segments, rectum).
limitations: Endoscopic findings have no anatomical coordinates without procedure metadata; they are never placed on this geometry.

systems.label: Nervous system
systems.summary: Whole-body nervous system layer and the atlas central/peripheral nervous structures in the shared body frame.
limitations: Nerve pathways absent from the source assets are never drawn or interpolated.

systems.label: Skeletal system
systems.summary: Full skeleton with regional bone groups, an écorché muscle study, and the atlas skeleton with individually named bones.
limitations: Fractures or bone lesions are displayed only from a validated detector with registration; none is configured.

systems.label: Hybrid full body
systems.summary: Switchable co-registered layers from one reference atlas frame, with optional unregistered comparison assets.

alignment.caveat: Estimated from bounding-box extents of a whole system; this is not landmark-based registration and does not verify internal correspondence.
Estimated from bounding-box extents of a whole system; this is not landmark-based registration and does not verify internal correspondence.

transform.caveat: Scale and position are fitted to overall height only. Internal correspondence with the atlas body is not established.

layers.label: Écorché — anatomy study (Beatriz Gomez Santamaria) — unregistered comparison

transform.caveat: Scale and position are fitted to overall height only. Internal correspondence with the atlas body is not established.

hybrid.review_workflow: Unregistered comparison layers can be reviewed in the studio; a review records the transform, metrics and reviewer decision.

limitations: Layers share one reference atlas frame; this is a generic adult male reference body, not the patient's anatomy.
Comparison assets from other sources are scale-aligned by bounding box only and are labelled UNREGISTERED.

systems.label: Kidneys and nephrons
systems.summary: Kidney exteriors and interiors (cortex, medullary pyramids, capsule, vessels), educational nephron models and the atlas urinary tract.
limitations: Nephron models are educational representations, never patient-specific microanatomy.
eGFR is computed only from a documented creatinine with the inputs a validated equation requires.
